name: current-base-cb209-metadata-layout-item-section-deterministic-api67-runtime
salesforceExclusionReason: This fixture exercises locally constructible Metadata layout item and section DTOs only; it makes no hosted Salesforce parity claim.

source.content: Metadata.LayoutItem i = new Metadata.LayoutItem(); i.analyticsCloudComponent = new Metadata.AnalyticsCloudComponentLayoutItem(); i.behavior = Metadata.UiBehavior.Required; i.canvas = 'canvas'; i.component = 'component'; i.customLink = 'link'; i.emptySpace = false; i.field = 'Name'; i.height = 10; i.page_x = 'page'; i.reportChartComponent = new Metadata.ReportChartComponentLayoutItem(); i.scontrol = 'control'; i.showLabel = true; i.showScrollbars = false; i.width = 'full'; System.assertEquals('Required', String.valueOf(i.behavior)); System.assertEquals('canvas', i.canvas); System.assertEquals('component', i.component); System.assertEquals('link', i.customLink); System.assertEquals(false, i.emptySpace); System.assertEquals('Name', i.field); System.assertEquals(10, i.height); System.assertEquals('page', i.page_x); System.assertEquals('control', i.scontrol); System.assertEquals(true, i.showLabel); System.assertEquals(false, i.showScrollbars); System.assertEquals('full', i.width); System.assertNotEquals(null, i.clone()); Metadata.LayoutSection s = new Metadata.LayoutSection(); s.customLabel = true; s.detailHeading = true; s.editHeading = false; s.label = 'Details'; s.layoutColumns = new List<Metadata.LayoutColumn>{new Metadata.LayoutColumn()}; s.style = Metadata.LayoutSectionStyle.OneColumn; System.assertEquals(true, s.customLabel); System.assertEquals(true, s.detailHeading); System.assertEquals(false, s.editHeading); System.assertEquals('Details', s.label); System.assertEquals(1, s.layoutColumns.size()); System.assertEquals('OneColumn', String.valueOf(s.style)); System.assertNotEquals(null, s.clone()); System.debug('GLADE_METADATA_LAYOUT_ITEM_SECTION_BATCH:pass');
